snippet.title: Game Boy - Nontan to Issho - Kuru Kuru Puzzle © 1994 Victor - Gameplay
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Nontan to Issho: Kuru Kuru Puzzle is a Puzzle game, developed by Access and published by Victor Interactive Software, which was released in Japan in 1994.
